description: Handwritten English task queries over a mixed CLI corpus. Small transparent smoke benchmark, not a held-out or general embedding leaderboard.
documents: backup
Save a recoverable snapshot of all project data.
restore
Recover project data from a previously saved snapshot.
delete
Permanently remove a snapshot and its stored contents.
login
Authenticate the current user using browser OAuth authorization.
logout
Revoke local credentials and end the authenticated session.
dns edit
Create or modify a domain's DNS records.
dns scopes
Configure OAuth permissions for domain name record management.
deploy
Publish an application build to the production server.
logs
Read recent server events and application error output.
doctor
Diagnose failed network connections and inspect service health.
mute
Silence incoming agent messages for this session until explicitly resumed.
unmute
Resume incoming agent messages after the session was silenced.
dm
Deliver a private text message to another agent's public key.
inbox
Read messages received by the current agent.
outbox
List messages awaiting delivery and their stored receipts.
file send
Offer a local file to another agent for transfer.
file receive
Download an offered file into a chosen local directory.
pay
Transfer money to a recipient using the configured wallet.
wallet balance
Read available funds in the current payment account.
profile
Read an agent's signed name, operator and capability metadata.
changelog
Show release notes and the history of changes between versions.
update
Install the newest published application version.
id
Show the current session's public identity key.
search
Find relevant passages in a knowledge collection.
embed
Convert text into learned numeric vectors for semantic comparison.
import
Load an existing data bundle into the local collection.
export
Write the selected knowledge collection to a portable data bundle.
verify
Check a data bundle's content hashes and integrity.
list
Show all locally available knowledge collections.
help
Display supported command options and argument syntax.
